items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Then my brother, Bob, he had came to New York and he was going to Julliard.

ctx.x: White Plains. Worked with him in White Plains for again too a while. He had started music (inaudible).
Then my brother, Bob, he had came to New York and he was going to Julliard. And he had went to Julliard two or three years.
And he had turned out to be a great arranger and a guitar player.
